script:
Li Hao (Bodyguard/Assassin)
In the 35th year of the Sea Calendar, Li Hao's entire family was massacred, and he nearly lost his life as well. Fortunately, a martial arts master saved him, taking an arrow for him and preserving his life. That martial arts master was called Zhang Qing. He was severely injured and went to a clinic for treatment. After recovering, he became dispirited and spent nearly a year drowning his sorrows in alcohol.
Li Hao stayed by Zhang Qing's side. While the two were wandering the world, they met a person. Li Hao didn't know this person's name, but he deeply remembered his appearance. This benefactor awakened the master and encouraged him to pursue a career. Because Li Hao was born with exceptional bone structure and was a once-in-a-century martial arts prodigy, the master also took him as a disciple.
On December 20th of the 35th year of the Sea Calendar, when Li Hao had achieved some success, Zhang Qing died tragically in a martial arts duel with others. This made Li Hao practice even harder - first, to pass on his master's life's work, and second, to avenge his master someday. When his master died, Li Hao began wandering the world alone. Only he knew that he was also an assassin - the legendary Black Kill of the martial world. Li Hao worked as a bodyguard to disguise his identity.
In the 42nd year of the Sea Calendar, Li Hao became famous as a bodyguard due to his high martial arts skills. Combined with his assassin identity, he accumulated a lot of money, enough for him to search everywhere for clues and investigate the cause of his master's death. He heard that the recently famous Longevity Gate was recruiting bodyguards, so Li Hao wanted to go there to investigate his master's affairs. The Longevity Gate was on an island. On the island, he met the cautious and careful boss Chu Wanhu and his young, beautiful wife Wang Tingting. Privately, Wang Tingting once whispered to Li Hao, "I've investigated you, Black Kill. Don't do anything out of line." There was also Chu Wanhu's son, the idle playboy Chu Chuan, as well as a doctor named Su Shengce.
The steward Ma San was exactly the benefactor in Li Hao's mind who had saved his master from danger. The steward also recognized him. When Li Hao asked the steward about what happened back then, the steward said nothing, only saying he would tell him later.
Li Hao never neglected his martial arts. Every night, Li Hao would practice his fists, feet, and archery.
[35th Year of Sea Calendar, September 27th]:
7 PM: That night, Ma San came to Li Hao's room and informed him that the killer of his master was actually Chu Wanhu. Chu Wanhu knew some martial arts before, but was far inferior to his master. However, poison was put in the tea on the day of the duel, and it was the doctor Su Shengce who poisoned it. Thus, Li Hao's target turned to the Chu Wanhu family and Dr. Su Shengce.
8 PM: After thinking for a long time, Li Hao decided to act. That night, Li Hao came to Su Shengce's door with a crossbow, but heard footsteps behind him. Li Hao quickly hid the crossbow and turned around to see Su Shengce. The killing intent in Li Hao's eyes frightened Su Shengce into kneeling and begging for mercy. Li Hao asked him about his master's affair. But Su Shengce didn't admit it, so Li Hao repeated Ma San's words to him.
But Su Shengce said he wasn't familiar with Chu Wanhu at all. He was only brought along because he was the town's only doctor, and there was no conspiracy to harm Li Hao's master. At the same time, Su Shengce said that Chu Chuan was his child and hoped Li Hao wouldn't implicate Chu Chuan.
Li Hao felt that Ma San's one-sided story was somewhat untrustworthy, so he went to Chu Wanhu's room to investigate.
8:30 PM: Li Hao came to Chu Wanhu and Wang Tingting's residence. He heard some movement inside just now and knew they weren't asleep. However, when he entered the room, there was no movement, not even breathing sounds. Li Hao felt something was strange and shot an arrow at the bed. There was the sound of a crossbow bolt entering flesh, but no one cried out. Li Hao was about to approach when he heard footsteps outside, so he quietly escaped through the window. With his extremely high martial arts skills, he made no sound.
Only Clue: Chu Chuan is Su Shengce's son.
acts_goal: Find the root cause of master's death.
